name: Sprocket
text:
Decision: We should build a lightweight “prompt health dashboard” that flags stale, redundant, or low-value prompts in real time and lets the team archive or refresh them with one click.

Why: Right now we waste cycles debating whether a prompt still works; a dashboard turns gut feelings into data. It keeps our prompt library lean and high-impact, which directly improves routing quality and reduces hallucinations from outdated instructions.

Trade-off: We accept a small upfront build cost and the risk that people ignore the dashboard if it’s noisy. We’ll mitigate that by starting with a strict “only show clear red flags” filter and iterating based on actual usage.
